request.query: Weighted order of determinant is bounded below by sum of column orders minus sum of row losses

items.name: Matrix.det_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : LinearOrder S]
  [IsStrictOrderedRing S] {n : Type u_3} [inst_5 : Fintype n] [inst_6 : DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n R}
  {abv : AbsoluteValue R S} {x : S},
  (∀ (i j : n), abv (A i j) ≤ x) → abv A.det ≤ (Fintype.card n).factorial • x ^ Fintype.card n

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul_ge
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g)

items.name: Matrix.abs_det_reindex
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : Fintype m] {R : Type u_3} [inst_4 : CommRing R] [inst_5 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
  (e₁ e₂ : m ≃ n) (A : Matrix m m R), |((Matrix.reindex e₁ e₂) A).det| = |A.det|

items.name: Matrix.detp
items.type: {n : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_3} → [Fintype n] → [DecidableEq n] → [CommSemiring R] → ℤˣ → Matrix n n R → R

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g) = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g
